input_text: On the issue of which car was responsible for a hit-and-run, the witness's statement in court that she believed it was the blue sedan.

extraction.input_text: On the issue of which car was responsible for a hit-and-run, the witness's statement in court that she believed it was the blue sedan.

claim.text: Is the statement described in this narrative hearsay under FRE 801(c)?

arguments.text: The narrative explicitly states the witness's statement was made 'in court,' which directly negates the 'out-of-court' requirement under FRE 801(c)(2).
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c)(2) requires a hearsay statement to be made outside of the current trial or hearing.

arguments.text: The statement contains an explicit assertion ('she believed it was the blue sedan'), satisfying the 'assertion' requirement under FRE 801(c)(1).
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c)(1) defines hearsay as a statement that the declarant asserts.
arguments.evidence_span: that she believed it was the blue sedan

arguments.text: The statement is offered 'on the issue of which car was responsible,' indicating it is offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted, satisfying FRE 801(c)(3).
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c)(3) requires the statement to be offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted.
arguments.evidence_span: On the issue of which car was responsible

arguments.text: Because the statement was made during direct testimony in court, it falls outside the definition of hearsay entirely, rendering the other prongs irrelevant to the final classification.
arguments.legal_rule: Statements made during live testimony at trial are not hearsay under FRE 801(c) regardless of their content or purpose.
